description.text:
Supreme (魁) is one of the three booster packs of Shining Synergy (交相辉映), the second Simplified Chinese release, on sale from 18 January 2023 alongside Shower (沐), Summon (唤) and a GX starter deck. Like the first release, its cards come from the Sun & Moon series. Shining Synergy brought TAG TEAM Pokémon-GX and TAG TEAM Supporters to the Simplified Chinese game, and with them Character Rare (CHR) cards, full-art cards showing a Pokémon together with a trainer, and special art versions of some cards. Five-card packs held one holo card, 25-card packs five.

Supreme holds the Grass, Psychic and Fighting Pokémon and the Trainers that go with them. Gengar & Mimikyu GX is on its cover. Its other TAG TEAMs include Marshadow & Machamp GX, Espeon & Deoxys GX, Mewtwo & Mew GX, Garchomp & Giratina GX and Celebi & Venusaur GX, with the TAG TEAM Supporters Guzma & Hala and Red & Blue and the Supporter Jessie & James. Its main cards are numbered out of 150; two CHR cards, full-art and special art cards and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 193.

Guzma & Hala (138/150 and the full-art 179/150) was misprinted with the wrong character in Guzma's name, 古兹玛 for 古兹马; the cards are still legal, and Pokémon exchanged them from 18 January to 18 July 2023. Arbok (038/150) and Weezing (053/150) name the Supporter Jessie & James as 武藏和小次郎 instead of 武藏与小次郎; they play as if the name were right.
